scientific_question: After result-blind canonical ordering of labeled camera packets, does one unchanged zero-start geometry-Jacobi strict PCGLS depth in the bounded global roster K1 through K64 satisfy every frozen absolute Case 12 field, full-gradient, interior-gradient, observation, per-cell, and complete-rig-tail gate across all 598 opened cells?
evidence_role: Post-open numerical repair of the v231 camera-order invalidity. The only allowed change is canonical camera-ID ordering before observation layout, operator assembly, Jacobi construction, and PCGLS. This experiment does not inspect invalid v231 depth arrays for selection and does not evaluate, recalibrate, or rescue the sealed dual-PRESS policy.

opened_scope.dataset: the already opened BLASTNet Case 12 payload and thirteen clean nine-camera rigs from v230

sealed_v231_numerical_parent.required_failure: camera-permutation and formal-independent numerical tolerances failed before any depth could be selected

solver_contract.only_allowed_change_from_v231: canonicalize every labeled active-camera packet before operator assembly and PCGLS
solver_contract.canonical_camera_order: strict ascending ASCII byte order over the unique active camera IDs, with no locale, case folding, geometry-derived ordering, truth, metric, or result dependence
solver_contract.canonical_observation_layout: reorder each complete 16x16x2 camera observation block by the same canonical camera-ID permutation before flattening
solver_contract.canonical_operator_layout: build true and reported geometry, operator rows, and exact Jacobi only after camera IDs and observation blocks are in canonical order
solver_contract.invalid_packet_rule: reject duplicate IDs, malformed IDs, a non-nine-camera packet, or an ID/block mismatch before any scientific array is written
solver_contract.preconditioner: same exact reported-geometry Jacobi diagonal with relative floor 1e-6
solver_contract.execution: one strict PCGLS trajectory per cell runs to K64 and saves every K1 through K64 checkpoint
solver_contract.selection_rule: select the smallest single global depth in ascending K1 through K64 order whose absolute summary passes; the same selected depth applies to every cell, frame, and rig; per-cell, per-frame, and per-rig depth selection are forbidden
solver_contract.nonmonotonicity_rule: every K1 through K64 checkpoint is evaluated; no monotonic convergence assumption may skip an earlier depth
solver_contract.v231_k16_numeric_continuity_is_not_requi: canonical ordering is the sole authorized floating-point representation change; v230/v231 identity and physical inputs remain sealed, but their order-sensitive K16 field is not a continuity target
solver_contract.camera_permutation_audit: for frame zero of every rig, independently canonicalize both the frozen packet order and its complete reversal, require identical canonical IDs and observations, rebuild geometry and Jacobi from canonical IDs, run the same K1 through K64 trajectory, and compare every checkpoint

independent_validation.second_PCGLS: separately coded recurrence that does not import the formal v232 runner
independent_validation.second_preprocessor: independent grid extraction and interpolation from v230 validator
independent_validation.second_jacobi: independent ray-row accumulation from v219 validator

decision_order: any protocol, source, v230/v231 parent, input, canonical packet, shape, finite, adjoint, call-ledger, camera-permutation, physical-residual, or independent-recomputation failure -> INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_CASE12_CANONICAL_PCGLS_REFERENCE_DEPTH_V232
valid execution but no global depth in K1 through K64 passes every frozen absolute gate -> FAIL_NO_ADEQUATE_CASE12_CANONICAL_PCGLS_REFERENCE_THROUGH_K64_V232
valid execution and at least one global depth passes -> PASS_MINIMAL_ADEQUATE_CASE12_CANONICAL_PCGLS_REFERENCE_DEPTH_V232 with the first passing depth
